Dear Distant Relative,

After many years of searching through various channels, I have finally discovered your email address. It is with great joy that I write to you as your long-lost distant relative. My name is Prince Yemi Ajibade of the Kingdom of Oyo, and I am contacting you with a most unusual family request.

I have come into an amount of wealth so large that it has become difficult for me to manage. Unfortunately, due to certain passport-related complications, I am unable to travel to your country myself. For this reason, I humbly ask for your assistance in transferring part of this fortune into your account, so that you may enjoy a comfortable and prosperous life.

I am prepared to transfer the sum of 20 million dollars to you. All I require is your credit card information so that the transfer may be completed without delay.

subject: Office Situation Follow-up
body:
Hi boss.

I wanted to check in after what happened in the office today. Things felt a little tense after the conversation near the break room, and I don’t want any awkwardness to carry into the rest of the week.

I know there has been some confusion about who was supposed to finish the client report, and I think that misunderstanding made the situation worse than it needed to be. A few people seemed frustrated, especially after the deadline got moved up, but I don’t think anyone meant for it to turn into a bigger issue.

For what it’s worth, I think it would help if everyone talked it through calmly tomorrow instead of letting rumors spread around the office. It’s already starting to feel like people are choosing sides, and that usually only makes things messier.

I’m not trying to blame anyone. I just think we should clear the air before it affects the project or makes the team uncomfortable. You’ve always been good at keeping things level-headed, so I wanted to let you know what I noticed.

Hopefully tomorrow is a little less dramatic.

Best,
Maya - Project Coordinator

Hey son,

I hope you're doing well. I feel like it's been a while since we last had a proper chat, so I wanted to reach out and see how you've been.

How are things on your end? What have you been up to lately? Still working on that big project you mentioned last time? And how are Timmy and Sandra doing? Did Timmy end up getting that bike he was hoping for?

As for me, I finally took that trip to the coast I've been talking about for ages. The weather was beautiful. I attached a bunch of photos from the trip so you can see what I've been up to.

Anyway, I also wanted to ask you about something. I'm trying to get some money sent over to your aunt's account to help her with some home repairs, and I'm completely lost with this online banking thing. Would you mind if I wired a small amount through you?
